name: SGM V2.01
description: A large GM/GS bank split into three SF2 parts to fit GitHub's file-size limit: presets 0-30, 31-79, and 80-127 plus every GS drum kit. Download all three parts to get the complete bank. GPL-3.0.

files.note: Three .tar.gz parts (about 270 MB total); a client cannot merge them into one bank, so this entry links the project page.
